scope: Dark Death Star starting first player and parsec; regular mobile movement in deep space, entering/leaving orbit; carried fleets and mounted weapons; Black 2 with Tarkin using no-hyperdrive transfers; mobile Turbolaser deployment/firing and second-weapon availability.
method: Real GEMP setup, movement, transfers, weapon deployment and firing. Initial board positions, Force and weapon destiny are controlled fixtures.
All nine observed outcome records compared exactly against native command replays with JSON round-trip projections.
The VirtualTableScenario framework normalizes opening hands, so its setup observation only covers first player and initial parsec. Native eight-card setup remains covered separately.
limitations: Component verification; production full-match admission stays closed.

Only 2_143 Death Star is registered. Light Death Star, Death Star II, nested mobile-system orbits, sectors, Attack Run/blown-away rules, Revolution itself and hyperspeed modifiers still require integration and conformance.

The pinned GEMP Weapons.numWeaponsAllowedToUse defaults mobile systems to one different weapon each turn; native follows the observed secondWeapon=false. AR p94 explicitly lists characters/vehicles/starfighters and capitals, but does not explicitly state a mobile-system number. This is engine-backed behavior, not a claim of an explicit printed one-weapon restriction.
Stale references, canceled arrivals, parsec 99, ordinary hand deployment, range changes, Core Shaft site-only control and responsive recovery have additional native-only checks.
